initialize_model_parallel_groups: initialize model parallel, data parallel, pipeline parallel, and context parallel process groups for distributed training
check_model_parallel_initialized: check if model parallel and data parallel groups have been initialized before use
get_model_parallel_rank: get the current rank within the model parallel group for this process
get_data_parallel_ranks: get the list of ranks in the data parallel group for this process
destroy_model_parallel: destroy and reset all model parallel, data parallel, pipeline parallel, and context parallel groups
